name: graphview
description: Internal research and personal-knowledge graph product workspace.

scripts.api:generate: uv run --package graphview-api python scripts/generate-openapi.py && pnpm exec openapi-typescript services/api/openapi.yaml -o packages/api-client/src/schema.ts
scripts.api:check: uv run --package graphview-api python scripts/check-openapi-drift.py && node scripts/check-generated-client.mjs
scripts.quality:fast: node scripts/run-local-checks.mjs lint security:local security:licenses changelog:check architecture:check api:check typecheck test release:check && pnpm --filter @graphview/web build
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter @graphview/api-contract test && pnpm --filter @graphview/worker-contract test && pnpm --filter @graphview/agent-gateway test && pnpm --filter @graphview/vscode-extension test
scripts.test:e2e:live: pnpm --filter @graphview/web exec playwright test tests/browser/live-stack.spec.ts --project=chromium-desktop --config playwright.config.ts
scripts.security:full: pnpm run security:local && pnpm run security:licenses && pnpm run security:audit && pnpm run security:osv && pnpm run security:secrets && pnpm run security:signatures
scripts.quality:full: pnpm run clean:artifacts && pnpm run quality:fast && pnpm run test:smoke && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run test:performance && pnpm run clean:artifacts
scripts.release:verify: pnpm run quality:full && pnpm run security:full && pnpm run test:deployment
